# Security Policy

Please do not open a public issue containing an exploitable vulnerability,
credential, private conversation, production endpoint detail, or personal data.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this repository. If that
feature is unavailable, contact the repository owner through the private
contact method listed on their GitHub profile and include only the minimum
information needed to establish contact. A secure channel can then be agreed
before sharing reproduction material.

This is a personal production/research project. Security reports are reviewed
on a best-effort basis; no response-time or bounty commitment is offered.

The system's architectural security and data-minimization boundaries are
documented in [`docs/SECURITY.md`](../docs/SECURITY.md).
